nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything tool ignore-pattern configuration, not part of the application

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat-config for the Angular workspace: applies TypeScript/Angular recommended and stylistic rules to .ts files (enforcing app/novedades-mf selector prefixes) and Angular template rules to .html files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tseslint.config() flat-config composition with a processor for inline Angular templates.

nodes.name: extra-webpack.config.js
nodes.summary: Custom webpack override for the single-spa Angular build: wraps single-spa-angular's generated webpack config and suppresses a style-loader runtime deprecation warning.

nodes.name: app.component.html
nodes.summary: Root application template: renders only a router-outlet to host the routed views of the microfrontend.

nodes.name: confirm-annul-modal.component.html
nodes.summary: Template for the confirm-annul-modal component: a warning-styled confirmation dialog showing contract/novelty details before annulling a novedad, with a debug-only 'force error' test switch.

nodes.name: confirm-novelty-modal.component.html
nodes.summary: Template for the confirm-novelty-modal component: a generic confirmation dialog summarizing a novedad (acta) before generation, with a warning banner and a debug-only 'force error' test switch.

nodes.name: contract-accordion.component.html
nodes.summary: Template for the contract-accordion component: a collapsible <details> card showing contract summary/details and a table of its novedades, with an 'add novedad' action menu and per-row annul/view-acta actions.

nodes.name: contract-info-card.component.html
nodes.summary: Template for the contract-info-card component: displays read-only contract metadata (type, number, object, value, contractor, term, supervisor) inside an app-card.

nodes.name: crear-adicion-prorroga.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for creating a contract addition-and-extension (adición y prórroga) novedad: a multi-section reactive form for budget addition and time extension, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: crear-cesion.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for creating a contract assignment (cesión) novedad: reactive form capturing assignee, disbursement values, and an optional additional 'considerando' clause, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: crear-poliza.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for registering the assignee's insurance policy (póliza) left pending after a cesión: form to pick the insurer and enter the policy number, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: crear-reinicio.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for creating a contract restart (reinicio) novedad after a suspension: reactive form for request/suspension/restart dates, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: crear-suspension.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for creating a contract suspension novedad: reactive form for office/date fields, suspension start/end dates with min-date constraints, motive text, and an optional additional clause, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: crear-terminacion.component.html
nodes.summary: Page template for creating an early-termination (terminación anticipada) novedad: reactive form for termination/certification dates and settlement amounts owed to contractor/university, plus success/error/confirmation states.

nodes.name: dashboard-contratos.component.html
nodes.summary: Main contracts dashboard template: search/filter panel (by year, contract number or contractor) plus a results list of contract-accordion cards, with modals for annulling a novedad and reactivating a finalized contract.

nodes.name: environment.development.ts
nodes.summary: Development environment configuration providing legacy UD backend API base URLs (novedades, core-amazon, administrativa) and OAuth2/OIDC token settings for local runs.

nodes.name: environment.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test/staging environment configuration mirroring development, but pointing the OAuth redirect and sign-out URLs at the pruebasnovedades staging host.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Application HTML shell that loads Roboto and Material Icons fonts and mounts the <novedades-mf> root single-spa web component.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet importing the Angular Material theme and web fonts, enabling Tailwind layers, and re-implementing a scoped Preflight-equivalent reset limited to the <novedades-mf> host so it doesn't leak into the single-spa shell.
nodes.languageNotes: Scopes what would normally be Tailwind's global Preflight reset to the novedades-mf host element selector, since the MFE shares the DOM with the single-spa shell without style isolation.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.js
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the design-system color palette, spacing, border-radius, and typography scale, and disabling Preflight (replaced by a scoped reset in styles.css) to avoid style leakage into the single-spa shell.
